name: UC PhD Projects
description: Explore every research project at CISUC / UC DEI — 400 of them — as interactive charts and a searchable catalogue. See which research groups run what, where the money comes from and goes, how project starts are spread over the years, who coordinates the most, and the biggest projects in each group. Open any project for its synopsis, budgets, partners, keywords, people and every field the site publishes about it.

agent_configs.name: UC PhD Research
agent_configs.description: Workspace MCP gateway plus workspace file access — researchers read datasets and write analysis files under .tmp/. Declared by reference (mcp_servers) so the live gateway URL and token are resolved from this workspace's own .mcp.json on every activation; nothing credential-bearing is committed here.

groups.name: UC PhD Researchers
groups.description: Qualitative-research assistants for Frederico's UC DEI PhD — thematic analysis per Braun & Clarke, grounded in the course's own framing.
groups.capabilities: Thematic coding and analysis of qualitative data (forum threads, transcripts, documents) following Braun & Clarke's six stages; multi-analyst reconciliation.

agents.name: PhD Researcher — Fable
agents.description: The cheap, fast analyst. Reach for this for a first coding pass, a broad sweep over a lot of material, or one of several independent readings you intend to reconcile.
agents.capabilities: Codes qualitative data independently per Braun & Clarke — candidate codes, a justified selected set of 8–12, and a rejected set with stated weaknesses — and revises it when shown other analysts' work.
use_cases: code a set of forum threads or transcripts
produce one independent reading for a multi-analyst comparison
run a refinement round over your own earlier coding

agents.name: PhD Researcher — Sonnet
agents.description: The default analyst. Reach for this unless the material specifically wants a cheaper pass or a deeper reading.
agents.capabilities: Codes qualitative data independently per Braun & Clarke — candidate codes, a justified selected set of 8–12, and a rejected set with stated weaknesses — and revises it when shown other analysts' work.
use_cases: code a set of forum threads or transcripts
produce one independent reading for a multi-analyst comparison
run a refinement round over your own earlier coding

agents.name: PhD Researcher — Opus
agents.description: The deep analyst, for material where the interpretation is the hard part — dense transcripts, contested readings, a coding pass that has to hold up in a write-up.
agents.capabilities: Codes qualitative data independently per Braun & Clarke — candidate codes, a justified selected set of 8–12, and a rejected set with stated weaknesses — and revises it when shown other analysts' work.
use_cases: code a set of forum threads or transcripts
produce one independent reading for a multi-analyst comparison
run a refinement round over your own earlier coding

agents.name: Quality Researcher
agents.description: The arbiter. Reconciles independent coding runs on concept agreement rather than wording, runs bounded refinement rounds, records dissent instead of overruling it, and synthesizes the final set. Also reviews a single analysis against the course's coding rules.
agents.capabilities: Reconciles several independent thematic analyses of the same data into one agreed set — concept mapping, a stated decision rule and threshold, bounded refinement rounds, recorded dissent and a synthesized final definition per code. Reviews analyses; never silently rewrites them.
use_cases: reconcile several analysts' coding of the same dataset
dispatch and judge a refinement round
review one coding pass against Braun & Clarke's rules

apps.reason: Provides both halves of this app's contributes.agents: the seeding surface itself (it is the provider core hands every app's declaration to) and the claude-runner-fable/-sonnet/-opus model slugs these four agents reference. Not required — without it nothing seeds at all, so the references can never dangle, and the rest of this app (dashboard, catalogue, MCP tools) works unchanged.
